audits.title: Audit Report of Central Venous Catheter Insertion Practices in a Teaching Hospital of Rawalpindi
audits.standard: Structured checklist based on Johns Hopkins Medicine and American Society of Anesthesiologists CVC insertion guidelines; satisfactory threshold 80%
audits.setting: Medical and Nephrology units, tertiary care teaching hospital, Rawalpindi (postgraduate residents)

cycle1.result: Compliance with key practices below the 80% threshold; full barrier precautions 47.1%; sterile draping 58.8%.

audits.intervention: Targeted intervention including educational materials and checklist-based guidance.
audits.other_findings: Same study appears as a second preprint (PPR1005418).
audits.citation: Bashir MS. Audit Report of Central Venous Catheter Insertion Practices in a Teaching Hospital of Rawalpindi. . 2025. doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-6405502/v1.

audits.title: Placement of central venous catheters in patients undergoing major maxillofacial surgery - a retrospective clinical audit.
audits.standard: All left subclavian CVC tips below the carina; distal 1 cm angled no more than 40 degrees to the SVC wall
audits.setting: Weekly major maxillofacial operating list, Northampton General Hospital

cycle1.result: 82% of catheter tips above the carina; 61% angulated >40 degrees; 11% met both standards (14% consultant-placed, 12% trainee-placed).

audits.other_findings: 89% of CVCs were not correctly placed; authors suggest 20 cm catheters for left subclavian lines (83 identified, 22 excluded).
audits.citation: Zochios V, Gilhooly M, Fenner S. Placement of central venous catheters in patients undergoing major maxillofacial surgery - a retrospective clinical audit. J Vasc Access. 2010;11(2):128-131. doi:10.1177/112972981001100208. PMID: 20119924.

audits.title: A checklist to improve the quality of central venous catheter tip positioning.
audits.standard: CVC tip in distal superior vena cava or cavo-atrial junction
audits.setting: Perioperative anaesthesia service, Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital, Queensland
audits.intervention: Standardised bundle of care and perioperative CVC insertion checklist.
audits.other_findings: Documentation of sterility measures, insertion depth and post-insertion tip position on chest radiograph substantially improved.
audits.citation: Hade AD, Beckmann LA, Basappa BK. A checklist to improve the quality of central venous catheter tip positioning. Anaesthesia. 2019;74(7):896-903. doi:10.1111/anae.14679. PMID: 31062348.

audits.title: Ultrasound Image Capture during Central Venous Catheter Insertions: A Quality Improvement Study.
audits.standard: SMART aim: ultrasound image capture of correct guidewire position in 2 planes before vessel dilation from 0% to 90%; supported by ASA and Society of Hospital Medicine recommendations
audits.setting: 48-bed quaternary paediatric ICU, Cincinnati Children's Hospital Medical Center

cycle1.result: 0% (no standard process to document guidewire position).

audits.intervention: Image capture and EHR upload workflow (laminated guide, later condensed to 1 page), image capture step and QR survey added to the central line observation guide, reminders and booster education, simulation in fellow boot camp, troubleshooting guide and visual aid on ultrasound machines.

cycle2.result: Successful image capture and upload 117/270 (44%) overall; monthly mean rose to 58%, peak 64%. DICOM order placement 194/270 (74%); mean 83%, peak 100%.

audits.other_findings: Aim of 90% not achieved; new fellows trained on the workflow at induction reached 70% vs 37% in the prior class; only 3 survey responses said the process took too much time.
audits.citation: Biniazan S, Lautz AJ, Mecoli M, Stalets EL, Zackoff MW. Ultrasound Image Capture during Central Venous Catheter Insertions: A Quality Improvement Study. Pediatr Qual Saf. 2025;10(6):e852. doi:10.1097/pq9.0000000000000852. PMID: 42137000.
